# Background Color of the Entire Webpage

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Background Color of the Entire Webpage

You can change the background color of an entire webpage by targeting the <body> or <html> element, as both tags cover all the visible content on a webpage.

Let's explore the code to do this:

```html
1<!DOCTYPE html>
2<html>
3
4<head>
5    <title>Background Color</title>
6</head>
7
8<body>
9    <h1>Welcome to Programiz!</h1>
10    <p>Dive into CSS and start turning boring web pages into something that actually looks good.</p>
11    <h2>Why Learn with Us?</h2>
12    <ul>
13        <li>Code in your browser.</li>
14        <li>Create real-world projects.</li>
15        <li>Get certified for in-demand skills.</li>
16    </ul>
17</body>
18
19</html>
```

```css
1body { 
2    background-color: gray;
3}
```

Browser Output

![CSS Body Background Color](data:image/png;base64,)

Changing the background color of the <body> section changes the color of the entire page.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)
